decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - That the London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby acknowledge the 28 day notification period and certify that on 7 March 2005 the proposed erection of 3x pole-mounted antennae and one radio equipment cabin to the buildings roof top and ancillary development thereto was NOT lawful within the meaning of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 and planning permission was required for the following reason:

The building is less than 15m in height and two of the 3x pole mounted antennae would be on a wall facing a highway which is within 20 metres of building.  The proposal therefore is not permitted under A.1(f) of Schedule 2, Part 24 (Development by Telecommunications Code System Operators) of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995.
description: Installation of 3 antenna's, 2 m/w dishes and associated telecommunications equipment to roof of existing building
